name: Gala Precision Engineering Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2009, Gala Precision 
 Engineering Ltd manufactures high-
quality Technical Springs and High 
Tensile Fasteners[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
GPEL manufactures precision components in India which includes Special Fastening Solutions (SFS) like High Tensile Fasteners such as Studs, Anchor Bolts, Cross Bolts, Hex Bolts, Nuts, Gallock Wedge Lock and Grip Lock Washers, asDisc and Strip Springs (DSS) and Coil & Spiral Springs (CSS), comprising an extensive portfolio of 750+ SKUs.

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 85.2% CAGR over last 5 years
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Debtor days have increased from 86.5 to 109 days.
Working capital days have increased from 102 days to 154 days
